description: Deletes a flow. Its schedules stop, guest share links die, and evals targeting it can no longer run (their binding shows flowOk: false) — check caliper_flow_performance for evals and workbench_flows_schedules_list before proposing, and prefer workbench_flows_update with archived: true when the user just wants it out of the way. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_flows_delete
title: Delete a Workbench flow
